description: This Java class 'JNDIConfigUtil' manages JNDI server configurations by loading and parsing an XML configuration file 'jndiservers.xml'. It provides methods to initialize, retrieve, and store JNDI server info objects.

classes.name: JndiServerInfo
classes.description: Immutable class representing JNDI server configuration details, including URL, factory, security info, and other attributes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads JNDI server configurations from an XML root element and populates the internal map.

methods.name: getJndiServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves JNDI server configuration details by server name.
